info.title: EmbodyStar MCP Content Server
info.description: Public, stateless MCP Streamable HTTP service for the published Markdown overview. Supports tools and resources, with no prompts or subscriptions. Uses protocol 2026-07-28 with compatibility for 2025-11-25, 2025-06-18, and 2025-03-26.

post.summary: Discover and retrieve the public overview through MCP
post.description: Use server/discover, tools/list, tools/call, resources/list, resources/templates/list, or resources/read. The tool is get_public_content with empty arguments; the resource URI is https://embodystar.com/. Current requests carry matching protocol metadata in params._meta and the header, plus Mcp-Method and Mcp-Name where applicable. Legacy clients can initialize and send notifications/initialized. Requests are bounded to 65536 bytes and need no session ID. The official MCP SDK handles the protocol; see the linked documentation for examples.

parameters.name: MCP-Protocol-Version
parameters.description: Required for current protocol requests; legacy initialize negotiates its version in params.protocolVersion.

parameters.name: Mcp-Method
parameters.description: Required for current protocol requests and must match method.

parameters.name: Mcp-Name
parameters.description: Required for current tools/call and resources/read; matches params.name or params.uri.

200.description: JSON-RPC result or protocol error. Tool calls return Markdown text content; resource reads return a text/markdown resource. Current protocol responses use JSON; legacy responses use request-scoped SSE.

400.description: Invalid JSON-RPC request, version, or mismatched protocol headers.

404.description: Unknown method for the current protocol.

406.description: Accept does not permit the required response media types.

405.description: This service has no persistent SSE stream. Use POST.
This stateless service has no sessions. Use POST.
